title: A quantitative bias analysis verdict scored as a classifier
question: How often does a QBA declare a MAIC decision robust when the true bias would reverse it, how does that depend on the elicited region rather than the method, and does oracle recovery reveal it?
design: Unanchored MAIC with an unmeasured binary confounder; elicited bias regions with exclusion probability set directly, three error directions and three widths; grid and probabilistic QBA scored on false reassurance and false fragility; 18 cells, 2000 replicates each.
